scripts.check: pnpm sql:check && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build && go test ./... && go vet ./...
scripts.sql:check: pnpm sql:generate && git diff --exit-code -- internal/dbquery src/generated/sql.ts
